notes: Direct HTTP/curl_cffi and headless Playwright were reconfirmed BLOCKED on all homedepot.com catalogue paths (403 from AkamaiGHost edge; safari17_0 impersonation only returns Akamai's behavioural-challenge interstitial, same as the prior Home-Decor pass). Escalated to Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3) per the brief, which reached the live site normally with no wall. robots.txt was already checked in the prior pass and has no Claude-specific disallow. Used the site's real 'Shop All > Shop By Department' mega menu (not text search, which mixes in irrelevant 'pet'-keyword hits like Bird Baths/Patio Chairs/Garden Statues) to find Pet Care: there is NO standalone 'Pet' top-level department; the pet department is nested at Outdoors > Pet Supplies & Wildlife (https://www.homedepot.com/b/Outdoors-Pet-Supplies-Wildlife/N-5yc1vZc4u1). Enumerated all 16 second-level nodes shown there and drilled into every PLP for the site's own 'Viewing X of Y' / 'N results' header text as qty evidence. INCLUDED (Pet Care): Dog Supplies (Dog Kennels/Beds/Houses/Pens), Cat Supplies (Cat Houses, Litter Box Enclosures, Litter Boxes, Cat Furniture>Cat Trees/Cat Beds/Cat Scratching Posts, Cat Cages, Cat Feeding Supplies>Cat Food Bowls/Cat Drinking Fountains & Water Dishes), Pet Cleaning Supplies (Pooper Scooper, Pet Stain & Odor Remover, Pet Seat Covers, Waste Disposal Systems), Pet Fencing & Training (Dog Park Equipment, Fencing Systems), Small Animal Supplies (Apparel & Accessories, Beds & Cages, Accessories, Feeding Supplies - rabbits/hamsters/ducks etc, Tier-2 generic names under a clearly pet-specific parent), Pet Fish Supplies (Fish Food & Health Care, Aquarium Decorations, Aquarium & Fish Tanks, Aquarium Filtration), Pet Bird Supplies (its own 'Bird Feeders' node for caged pet birds - distinct URL/node from the wild-bird one - plus Bird Cages & Carriers, Pet Bird Healthcare), Reptile & Amphibian Supplies (Food, Reptile Supplies, Habitats & Decor). EXCLUDED as not Pet Care (site nav checked, not decided from a leaf name alone): 'Bird & Wildlife Supplies' and its children Bird Baths / Bird Feeders / Bird Seed & Food / Hummingbird Feeders - confirmed via that node's own page (2,512 results) to be backyard/wild-bird and wildlife-attracting products, not supplies for an owned pet; 'Beekeeping Supplies' - bees are not pets; 'Hunting Gear' and 'Fishing Gear' - these two menu entries actually resolve to N-5yc1vZc40t/c45t under the separate 'Sports-Outdoors' taxonomy branch (human sporting goods), not under Pet-Supplies-Wildlife at all, despite appearing in this department's side menu. DROPPED (zero results, per rule): 'Automatic Cat Feeders' (0 results). FLAGGED per the brief's two open policy gaps: Fish Food & Health Care (3) and Reptile & Amphibian > Food (5) as PET CONSUMABLE/mixed medical; Pet Bird Healthcare (1) as PET MEDICAL/VETERINARY. FLAGGED per this task's specific instruction (unresolved livestock/farm-animal boundary, same open question as Castorama's chicken coops): the entire 'Farm Animal & Horse Supplies' node and its 4 children Chicken Coops (258), Tanks/Waterers/Feeders (4), Chicken Runs (17), and Horse Supplies (41) - recorded, not silently dropped, but not decided in/out by this worker. No overlaps/duplicate-link merges were needed; every recorded leaf has a distinct canonical /b/ URL. Grouping-vs-leaf: 'Dog Supplies' (823 total) and 'Farm Animal & Horse Supplies' (555 total) are both browsable AND have real children, so per the no-double-count rule they are emitted as is_group rows (qty null) with their children as the counted leaves; children summed do not equal the parent total in these two cases because the parent PLP also contains additional ungrouped SKUs (e.g. dog ramps, dig barriers under Dog Supplies) that the site does not expose as their own named sub-category - Fish Supplies and Reptile & Amphibian Supplies, by contrast, sum exactly to their parent totals (26=26, 56=56).
